title: MukhaSpectra ScreeningResult

fvl_threshold.description: Relative-AF threshold below which tissue is FVL.
fvl_threshold.title: Fvl Threshold

porphyrin_red_fraction.description: Fraction of mucosa with red (porphyrin) fluorescence.
porphyrin_red_fraction.title: Porphyrin Red Fraction

reference_green.description: Median exposure-normalised green fluorescence of the reference.
reference_green.title: Reference Green

ArecaNutUse.description: Areca nut without tobacco (supari, paan without tobacco). Linked to submucous fibrosis.
ArecaNutUse.title: ArecaNutUse

artifact.description: Artifact key of the stored image.
artifact.title: Artifact

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact config file used.
sha256.title: Sha256

research_use_opt_in.description: Separate opt-in to use de-identified data to improve the tool.
research_use_opt_in.title: Research Use Opt In

points.description: Contribution to the rule score; may be negative.
points.title: Points

Diascopy.description:
Pressing a glass slide on a dark (FVL) area. If fluorescence returns, the darkness was
most likely blood/inflammation rather than a tissue change.
Diascopy.title: Diascopy

contrast_vs_surround.description: Mean relative AF of a ring around the region / region mean. >1 = darker.
contrast_vs_surround.title: Contrast Vs Surround

score.description: Rule score. Always read together with the factors.
score.title: Score

validated.description: Always false in schema v1: no MukhaSpectra model has a documented clinical validation. A validated model requires a new schema version.
validated.title: Validated

model_card.description: Path or URI of the model card.
model_card.title: Model Card

NormPoint.description: Point in normalised image coordinates of the white-light frame (0..1, origin top-left).
NormPoint.title: NormPoint

prototype_banner.default: Research prototype — not for clinical use
prototype_banner.title: Prototype Banner

disclaimer.default: Screening aid — not a diagnosis. MukhaSpectra flags suspicious findings and assigns a risk level to support triage. Final diagnosis requires examination by a clinician and histopathology.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

PatientInfo.description:
Minimised clinical view of the patient. Name and contact details live in a separate PII
store keyed by ``pseudonymous_id`` and are joined only when a report is rendered.
PatientInfo.title: PatientInfo

message_key.description: i18n key for the retake prompt, e.g. 'qc.blur'.
message_key.title: Message Key

passed.description: False if any issue has severity 'error'.
passed.title: Passed

warp_matrix.description: 3x3 matrix mapping AF pixel coordinates into the WL frame (working res).
warp_matrix.title: Warp Matrix

SiteArtifacts.description: Artifact keys (relative paths in the result's artifact store).
SiteArtifacts.title: SiteArtifacts

suspicion_score.description: Heuristic 0..1 score. Not a calibrated probability.
suspicion_score.title: Suspicion Score

hb_absorption_proxy.description: Depth of the 540-580 nm haemoglobin dip relative to a 515->630 nm baseline.
hb_absorption_proxy.title: Hb Absorption Proxy

signal_type.description: 'reflectance' when calibrated (S-D)/(W-D); otherwise dark-subtracted signal normalised to its own spectral sum.
signal_type.title: Signal Type

overrides_applied.description: Clinical red-flag floors. The device can never lower these.
overrides_applied.title: Overrides Applied

VisualFlag.description: What the health worker saw with their own eyes at this site.
VisualFlag.title: VisualFlag

description: Everything known about one screening, one analysis version.

synthetic.description: True if any input is synthetic.
synthetic.title: Synthetic
